elias.desc: Elias, a lean weary man around forty with shoulder-length straight dark hair, light stubble and hollow grieving eyes, in a black suit, white shirt and thin black tie

bell.desc: Augustin Bell, an old watchmaker around seventy with a short white beard, kind sharp eyes, a jeweller's loupe on his brow, a brown waistcoat over a white shirt with rolled sleeves, a cherry-wood pipe

nero.desc: Nero, a tan-and-black German shepherd dog with a red collar

hale.desc: Inspector Hale, a tired middle-aged detective with a lined face, a grey moustache and heavy-lidded eyes, in a grey trench coat and a grey fedora hat with the brim pulled low

marchetti.desc: Salvatore Marchetti, a huge heavy-set fishmonger mob boss around fifty with a thick neck, slicked-back black hair, a broken nose and a gold fish-scale necklace, in a blood-stained rubber apron over a dirty undershirt and rubber boots

saltmen.desc: rough dock workers in yellow oilskin coats, yellow sou'wester rain hats, grey wool sweaters and black rubber boots

malaspina.desc: Don Lucien Malaspina, a huge bald nightclub owner around fifty with a full thick black beard, heavy brows, a gold earring and gold rings, in a long dark fur coat over a purple silk shirt, holding a black cane with a silver head

switch.desc: Switch, a wiry young punk woman around twenty-eight with short cropped platinum-blonde hair shaved at the sides, a pale sharp face with freckles and a manic gap-toothed grin, brass welding goggles pushed up on her forehead, a long clean bright red railway work coat with brass buttons, a leather bandolier of rusty iron rail spikes across her chest, a steel chain whip with a hook wound around one forearm, black cargo trousers and heavy black boots

tinder.desc: Tinder, a thin bony man around thirty-five with a gaunt soot-smeared face, a shiny burn scar on his left cheek, patchy stubble, greasy dark hair, round black welder's goggles on his forehead, a scorched brown leather welder's apron over a filthy grey undershirt, a bandolier of glass bottles with rag wicks across his chest, holding a burning road flare

rats.desc: young street punks in layered dark hoodies and patched work jackets, rain-soaked beanies, scarves pulled over their mouths, patched jeans, pale soot-smeared skin

brask.desc: Count Teodor Brask, a tall thin aristocrat around sixty with slicked-back silver hair, a thin silver moustache, a sharp hawk nose and a narrow face, a round monocle on a thin gold chain over his right eye, in an immaculate white tuxedo jacket with a black bow tie and a red carnation, white gloves, a black cane with a silver crook handle

cooler.desc: Bruno the Cooler, a huge muscular bouncer around forty-five with a shaved head, a thick neck, a flat broken nose, small cold grey eyes and a heavy jaw, in a tight black tuxedo straining at the shoulders, gold knuckle-dusters on both fists

mags.desc: Mags, a tough woman bartender around thirty-five with shoulder-length wavy copper-red hair, a few freckles, sharp green eyes and red lipstick, in a worn black leather jacket over a dark green top

house.desc: casino security men in black tuxedos with white shirts, black bow ties and coiled earpieces

kalt.desc: Nerissa Kalt, a tall cold smuggler queen around forty-five with short grey-blonde hair slicked back wet, pale ice-blue eyes, high cheekbones and thin lips, in a black neoprene wetsuit under a long open dark olive oilskin coat, a diving knife strapped to her thigh, holding a pneumatic harpoon gun

teague.desc: Hollis Teague, a huge barrel-chested dockmaster in an old brass deep-sea diving helmet with a round glass faceplate showing a scarred bearded face, a heavy canvas diving suit, lead boots, a short iron anchor on a chain over his shoulder

undertow.desc: smugglers in black wetsuits and dark oilskin jackets

krieg.desc: Dr. Anselm Krieg, a gaunt very tall surgeon around sixty with sparse grey hair combed straight back, a long pale waxy face with sunken cheeks, deep-set pale eyes and thin bloodless lips, a surgical headlamp strapped on his forehead, in a pale green surgical gown open over a dark grey three-piece suit, latex gloves, a battery bone saw in his right hand

orderlies.desc: hospital orderlies in white coats and pale green scrubs with surgical masks over their faces and latex gloves

vane.desc: Commissioner Augusta Vane, a stern upright woman around fifty-five with short neatly styled silver hair, a hard handsome face with a strong jaw, cold grey eyes and thin pressed lips, in a dark navy police dress uniform with gold braid on the shoulders and rows of medals on her chest, white gloves

brandt.desc: Sergeant Ruud Brandt, a huge broad riot police sergeant around fifty with a grey crew cut, a thick grey walrus moustache, a weathered square face and a scar through one eyebrow, in black riot armour with shoulder pads, holding a full-height steel tower shield with a gun slot and a combat shotgun

lenz.desc: Viktor Lenz, a slim pale young man around thirty with slicked-back white-blond hair, a pale beautiful cold face, high cheekbones and light grey eyes, in an immaculate white three-piece suit with a thin black tie, carrying a black violin case

bluechoir.desc: corrupt riot policemen in dark navy uniforms and black riot helmets with visors
